note: Hand-authored evidence mapping from Libella's executed units to the OWASP API Security Top 10 2023 risks. A risk is evaluated, not 'passed': completed_no_issue only means the mapped check ran and found nothing, and only for a check that directly tests the risk. Per-unit CWE lists keep a finding on the risk its own check tests (an api_audit CWE-200 is excessive data exposure, API3; a graphql_audit CWE-200 is introspection, API8).

rows.why: OpenAPI-driven probes across declared roles: another user's object by id, privileged functions with a low-privilege identity, writable privileged properties, credential fields in responses, and operations the spec marks authenticated

rows.note: agent api role drives the same api_audit probes

rows.why: GraphQL introspection exposure, per-role object and function authorization queries, and depth/alias/batch cost probes
authenticated read of another identity's object by id, compared with the expected denial
operator-declared internal URL must be fetched by the application and its marker returned
foreign Origin reflected with credentials is one misconfiguration among many that API8 covers
missing security headers on API responses are one part of API8
reachable debug, monitoring and documentation endpoints are both a misconfiguration and an inventory gap
transport configuration of the API endpoint is part of API8
rendered and static crawl plus JavaScript route mining build the endpoint inventory API9 is about; it records, it does not judge

unmapped.web_checks: the web role's parameter checks are attributed through their individual units
unmapped.verify: replays a candidate's proof; tests nothing new

manual.API: needs an analyst who understands the API's intended behaviour and roles

manual_overrides.API6:2023: sensitive business flows (purchase, booking, referral) must be identified with the owner and abused deliberately; no generic probe can know which flow is sensitive
manual_overrides.API10:2023: unsafe consumption is about how the API treats data from the third-party APIs it calls; it needs source review or a controlled upstream, not black-box requests
